notes: Counting: claims_audited counts distinct assertions (relevance sentences, concept sub-claims, table cells, pattern signal/diagnosis/follow-up, When-to-Use bullets, worked-example steps, anti-patterns, integration rows, integrity-note items); faithful = claims_audited - findings; a finding covering several sub-claims on one line counts once. Every quoted span was checked mechanically against the deep ref and the converted source (curly/straight quotes normalised), then mismatches read by hand. The distillation's Wise Crowds group size (line 98, '5–6 person groups') is correct, unlike the other three LS distillations. Hypothetical questions and scripts in quotation marks (worked example, integration) were read as the distillation's own wording. Quoted Network Weaving periphery questions in table cells (line 121) are verbatim and were not graded for the missing marker, consistent with the table-cell convention used across these audits. Converted source consulted for Introduction, Ownership, Choosing Space, Aesthetics, Working with Space, Storyboard, Nothing About Me, Unusual Suspects, Report Outs, Wise Crowds, Speed Networking, 1-2-4, DAD, World Café, Network Weaving, Talking Objects, Take 20 Seconds. Other deep refs checked: lfuo-learning-review-guide-2024-deep (Ten Principles and Agreements, deflection questions, administrative firewall), tc-25-20-army-aar-deep (horseshoe arrangement line 111; AAR vs critique), scrum-guide-2020-deep (events, containers), nhs-just-culture-guide-deep (wider actions; families as audience), openstax-organizational-behavior-deep (Tuckman, conflict; no servant leadership or communication networks), openstax-business-ethics-deep (no Mitchell-Agle-Wood), ssdl-systems-thinking-foundations-deep (Group Model Building, line 85: confirmed), letaw-handbook-sweng-methods-deep (Tuckman, fist-of-five, RACI, elicitation, paper prototyping, Inclusivity Heuristics: confirmed). Marker counts were computed with grep -o over the deep ref.
